caption:
Letting the bread cool

Letting the bread cool.

Bread keeps setting as it cools, so a loaf cut while it is hot turns gummy inside.

For whoever cuts the loaf while it is still hot.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, and a steaming loaf of bread sits on the right. A speech bubble says fresh bread! with wide eyes and a pulse. Then cut it now? with a lean toward the loaf. Then wait with narrowed eyes. Then still warm as the steam thins out. Then now, with no steam left, and the figure's eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me waiting for the bread to cool. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
